subject: Request: Trial runway extension for BlueBridge Health — integration delay
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bluebridgehealth.com>, David Park <david.park@bluebridgehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox access + trial runway — quick alignment

Emma / David,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I’ve provisioned the sandbox and shared the connector docs. I see from your engineering notes that the BlueBridge EHR connector and SSO integration are creating a longer blocker than expected.

Given the dependency on the connector team, would you be open to a short runway extension so your engineers can complete the integration and run the end-to-end tests? We can provide an additional credit top-up and keep the sandbox active while you validate latency/throughput against demo data.

If helpful, I’m happy to pull Marissa (AM) into a quick 30-minute working session to prioritize the remaining blockers and map a timeline. Please share a short list of the outstanding items and an ETA your team is comfortable with.

Attachments: integration_issue_summary.pdf (high-level), connector-integration-guide.pdf (link shared separately)

Best,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0178
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bluebridgehealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Park <david.park@bluebridgehealth.com>, procurement@bluebridgehealth.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sandbox access + trial runway — quick alignment

Avery —

Really appreciate the quick follow-up. Our integration team ran into two items we hadn’t fully scoped:

• SSO cert rotation behavior between Redwood’s test IdP and our staging environment (blocks sign-on flows for some service accounts)
• EHR connector mapping: a mismatch on a custom patient identifier that causes the ingestion pipeline to reject ~8% of records

Both are fixable but will take our team 10–14 business days to remediate and validate in staging. Procurement is copied — they’ll need a written confirmation of any extended sandbox time and the credits that would be applied.

Could you outline what a 30-day runway extension would look like (credit amount, SSO test guidance, any constraints)? We’d also like to lock a 30-minute follow-up the week after fixes are in to validate performance.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
BlueBridge Health
emma.liu@bluebridgehealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bluebridgehealth.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access + trial runway — quick alignment

Emma / David —

Thanks for the details — totally makes sense. We want to make sure your engineers have the runway to finish the SSO and connector mapping without losing progress. Proposed approach: 

1) Trial runway: extend sandbox access + test cluster for 30 days from the date we enable the extension.
2) Credits: apply $6,000 worth of platform credits to your account to cover additional token usage during integration and validation (covers typical EHR ingestion testing at our observed throughput).
3) Support: assign Marissa (AM) + an engineer from our integrations team for two ad-hoc troubleshooting sessions (30–60 min) to help debug the SSO cert rotation and mapping issue.
4) Procurement: if you’re comfortable we can draft a short SOW (no charge) that covers the extension and outlines the credit application; I’ve attached a draft (SOW-draft-v3.pdf) we can iterate.

Ben — can you confirm whether the $6,000 credit is available under our extension approvals and share any required approval code for procurement?

Emma, if that looks reasonable I’ll queue the extension and the first troubleshooting slot — please suggest 2x times that work for your integration lead.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bluebridgehealth.com>, procurement@bluebridgehealth.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access + trial runway — quick alignment

Marissa / team —

Approved. We can apply a one-month runway extension and a $6,000 credit top-up against BBH-2026-042. Approval code: RBW-EXT-1126-BBH.

Notes for procurement: the extension is provided as a non-recurring credit applied to the account; no automatic renewal. Please confirm acceptance by replying to this thread and sign the attached SOW (SOW-draft-v3.pdf) if you’d like the extension documented. I’ll attach the execution-ready SOW and the integration_logs.zip (sanitized sample logs you can share with your team) to the final email.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BBH-2026-042

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@bluebridgehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, David Park <david.park@bluebridgehealth.com>, procurement@bluebridgehealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sandbox access + trial runway — quick alignment

Ben / Marissa / Avery —

Thank you — we accept the one-month extension and the $6,000 credit. Procurement confirms they have what they need to record the credit (procurement@bluebridgehealth.com). We’ll sign the SOW and return it within 72 hours.

Next steps from our side:
• Integration lead will schedule a troubleshooting session with Marissa for 11/20 or 11/22 (TBD).
• We’ll aim to complete the fixes and validation by 12/08 and propose a final demo week of 12/13–12/17.

Appreciate the flexibility — this keeps momentum while our EHR vendor resolves the mapping edge case.

Best,
Emma Liu
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
BlueBridge Health
emma.liu@bluebridgehealth.com
